title: Act: Export ResolveKey type and exhaust the effect switch in effectContext
summary: Name the resolveKey type for effect context
description: Add an exported ResolveKey type to effectContext.ts and use it for the resolveKey parameter, so tests can build a typed mock.
acceptance_criteria: Given effectContext.ts, When imported, Then ResolveKey is an exported type (id: string) => string
Given createEffect, When called, Then behavior is unchanged
